Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
Markets.summary: Indian equities closed marginally higher on Friday as gains in financials, metals, and small-caps offset losses in IT stocks. Analysts expect market volatility to remain elevated, driven by crude prices, foreign capital flows, and global trends.

Markets.title: 20 IPOs on investors' radar next week. GMPs indicate up to 90% returns
Markets.summary: Investors are tracking 20 upcoming initial public offerings and listings across the mainboard and SME segments next week. Grey market premiums indicate potential listing gains ranging from 56.7% to 107% for top-performing stocks like Symbiotec Pharmalab and Tempsens Instruments.

Markets.title: FPIs invest Rs 23,544 crore in Indian equities in Aug on earnings revival, rupee stability
Markets.summary: Foreign Portfolio Investors invested Rs 23,544 crore in Indian equities during August due to corporate earnings revival and rupee stability. This followed a heavy selling streak from March through June, during which FPIs withdrew a total of over Rs 2.60 lakh crore.

Markets.title: Pride Hotels steps up expansion, plans Rs 1,000-cr IPO by December
Markets.summary: Pride Hotels is expanding its portfolio from 40 to 72 properties over the next two years through new managed and owned locations. The company also plans to launch a Rs 1,000-crore initial public offering (IPO) by December.

Markets.title: Mcap of four of top-10 most valued firms erodes Rs 87,960 cr; Airtel takes biggest hit
Markets.summary: While four of India's top ten most valuable firms lost a combined Rs 87,960 crore in market capitalization, Bharti Airtel suffered the largest decline. Conversely, Reliance Industries gained Rs 8,119.53 crore to reach Rs 17,78,175.59 crore, and Larsen & Toubro added Rs 3,487.83 crore.

Markets.title: 10 midcap stocks with massive upside potential of up to 55%! Do you own any?
Markets.summary: Analysts have identified ten Nifty Midcap 100 stocks with projected 12-month gains ranging from 23% to 53%. Patanjali Foods, Vishal Mega Mart, and Suzlon Energy lead the list with Strong Buy ratings.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
Geo-Political.summary: Following the collapse of trade talks and Canada's announcement of retaliatory tariffs, Donald Trump claimed that Canada wants the benefits of becoming a U.S. state. Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau accused the United States of starting a trade war.

Geo-Political.title: Zelensky has 'questions to answer' about corruption in his government, sacked minister tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine's recently dismissed defence minister stated that President Zelensky must address government corruption. He also called for national elections to be held in Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Girl, 17, killed in Swedish sword attack, police say
Geo-Political.summary: A 17-year-old girl was killed and two boys aged 12 and 17 were injured in a sword attack in Sweden. An 18-year-old suspect has been detained by police in connection with the incident.

Geo-Political.title: Father leaves 7-year-old son alone on Mount Fuji to continue hike
Geo-Political.summary: A Japanese man abandoned his tired seven-year-old son alone on Mount Fuji to continue his hike. Police later rescued the boy uninjured and questioned the father about the incident.

Geo-Political.title: The hotel booking mix-up that could free mushroom murderer
Geo-Political.summary: Erin Patterson's lawyers are using evidence involving a table tennis tournament and a throat lozenge to challenge her murder convictions. They argue that a hotel booking mix-up proves crucial details of the case were flawed.

Geo-Political.title: Robots compete in boxing, football and sprinting at World Humanoid Games
Geo-Political.summary: The second-edition World Humanoid Games kicked off in Beijing, China, on Saturday. Robots are competing in boxing, football, and sprinting during the five-day event.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.title: India gets FDI approvals of  ₹4,896 cr under eased norms for land-border countries; not clear origin is from China
Data & Insights.summary: India has approved ₹4,896 crore in foreign direct investments under eased norms for countries sharing a land border. It remains unclear whether the origin of these investments is from China.

Data & Insights.title: India economic growth may beat RBI forecast: Deputy governor says 7% pace possible as indicators improve
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta stated that India's economic growth could surpass the central bank's 6.7% forecast and reach nearly 7%. This positive outlook is driven by stronger-than-expected economic indicators, while financial markets increasingly anticipate a rate hike later this year.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector growth likely picked up in August: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector growth likely accelerated in August, according to the HSBC Flash India PMI survey. This advance estimate provides an early indicator of positive shifts in the country's economic output and sentiment.

Data & Insights.title: Consumers queue up for premium petrol as E20 concerns refuse to die down
Data & Insights.summary: Fears that ethanol-blended E20 petrol reduces vehicle mileage and engine life have prompted consumers to switch to premium, high-octane fuel. Consequently, premium petrol sales surged from roughly 4 percent in March to 12 to 15 percent.

Data & Insights.title: India allows duty-free sugar imports as prices surge
Data & Insights.summary: To lower record-high domestic prices, the Indian government has reduced its import duty on sugar to zero. This decision follows earlier actions to ban sugar exports and tighten stock holding limits.

India.title: 8.23 Lakh Government Posts Vacant: RTI Shows Massive Workforce Gaps
India.summary: An RTI application revealed that over 8.23 lakh government posts are currently vacant across India. This leaves more than one in five sanctioned government positions without an employee in position.

India.title: IIT Kharagpur Outreach Network Launches Texas AI Learning Centre In Houston
India.summary: The IIT Kharagpur Outreach Network has opened the Texas AI Learning Centre in Houston. The new facility aims to advance artificial intelligence education, professional training, and industry partnerships.

India.title: 14-Year-Old Daughter Of Rohit Pawar's Assistant Found Dead Near Home In Baramati
India.summary: Avani Ajit Dashavatare, the 14-year-old daughter of politician Rohit Pawar's personal assistant, was found dead near her home in Baramati on Sunday morning. Local authorities are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident.

India.title: Indian Shop Owner Shot Dead During Robbery In Front Of Teen Daughter In US
India.summary: Suresh Parsottamdas Patel, an Indian shop owner from Gujarat's Mehsana, was shot and killed during a robbery in the US. The incident occurred in front of his teenage daughter.

India.title: Pregnant Defence Ministry Officer Found Dead, Family Alleges Abuse By In-Laws
India.summary: Nazia Khanam, a pregnant assistant section officer in the Defence Ministry, was found dead four months after marrying Azam Ali Khan on April 11. Her family has accused her in-laws of abusing her.

India.title: UPSC CDS 2 Admit Card 2026 Soon: Check Expected Release Date
India.summary: The Union Public Service Commission will soon release the admit card for the Combined Defence Services 2 exam. The examination is scheduled to take place on September 13, 2026.

General.title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
General.summary: After trade talks collapsed, Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau announced retaliatory tariffs and accused the United States of starting a trade war. In response, Donald Trump claimed that Canada wants the benefits of becoming a U.S. state.

General.title: Mayors to get powers to overrule local councils on planning decisions
General.summary: Housing minister Matthew Pennycook announced that mayors will receive new powers to overrule local councils on planning decisions. The government views this change as essential to help mayors effectively deliver new homes.

General.title: Zelensky has 'questions to answer' about corruption in his government, sacked minister tells BBC
General.summary: Ukraine's recently dismissed defense minister stated that President Zelensky must address government corruption. He also called for the country to hold new elections.

General.title: Plan to restrict serious offenders to certain areas to start in October
General.summary: Starting in October, serious violent and sexual offenders leaving prison on probation may be confined to specific areas of just a few miles. This plan aims to restrict their movement after their release.

General.title: Robots compete in boxing, football and sprinting at World Humanoid Games
General.summary: The second-edition of the five-day World Humanoid Games began in Beijing, China, on Saturday. Robots are competing in events such as boxing, football, and sprinting.

General.title: Lucy Davis 'grateful' for support over cancer diagnosis
General.summary: Actress Lucy Davis expressed gratitude for public support following her recent cancer diagnosis. The Office star made this statement at a convention in London less than two weeks after announcing her condition.
